bug_fix_verification.bug_description: Admin-approved weekend working entries with < 4.5 hours were not showing up in Attendance and Salary modules due to hardcoded OT threshold of >= 4.5 hours
bug_fix_verification.fix_description: The fix bypasses the >= 4.5 hours threshold if the entry has from_weekend_approval == True in work_entries DB collection
